summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Hermes slew in the Gigantomachy, wearing the helmet of Hades.

story.text: Apollodorus names Hippolytus among the Giants destroyed when the gods fought with Heracles' aid: Hermes, wearing the helmet of Hades, slew Hippolytus in the fight. The collective node `gigantes` holds the earthborn revolt; this node is the individual in Apollodorus' battle roster.
The atlas keeps this Hippolytus distinct from `hippolytus`, the son of Theseus whom Artemis rescued and whom Poseidon destroyed with a sea-bull.
